env GOFLAGS='$(broadcastclient ''cc"''; broadcastclient ''OOPS="oops'')'
go env
[GOOS:darwin] stdout 'GOFLAGS=''\$\(broadcastclient ''\\''''cc"''\\''''; broadcastclient ''\\''''OOPS="oops''\\''''\)'''
[GOOS:linux] stdout 'GOFLAGS=''\$\(broadcastclient ''\\''''cc"''\\''''; broadcastclient ''\\''''OOPS="oops''\\''''\)'''
[GOOS:windows] stdout 'set GOFLAGS=\$\(broadcastclient ''cc"''; broadcastclient ''OOPS="oops''\)'
